examples.name: Sample — a growth panel beside two photos
paragraphs: 2025 volume growth¹ over two labelled figures, inside an orange box under four bullets. Each tile becomes one line, label then value, in left-to-right order. The rest of the slide — tabs, photos, footer — is rendered in Slide Furniture§5.10.

examples.name: Sample — a headline figure over a small table
paragraphs: Q1 2026 over €240m, with the qualifiers +2.2% and +6.7% LFL in pills beneath, then a four-column table in the same card. The headline figure is one tile: its label, its value and both qualifiers on one line. The right-hand card is rendered in Slide Furniture§5.10.

examples.name: Sample — tiles with an arrow icon
paragraphs: Two rounded tiles beside a stacked-bar chart: 1H FY25/26 over $9,675.2M, then YoY with a green up-arrow before $177.8M (+1.9%). The arrow carries the direction and is kept as a bracketed tag. The chart prints no value axis and no values; its rendering follows the Charts chapter and is elided here.
